# <span id="aanchor406"></span> Ticket Validations

Ticket validations allow you to attach validation templates to a location to validate attached tickets.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 466;height: 396;" />

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Add">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Add a Validation</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Add">

<div class="procedure">

To add a ticket validation template:

1.  Click **Edit**.
2.  Select a validation template from the drop-down menu.
3.  Click the **add** button 

<img src="data:image/png;base64," style="vertical-align: text-bottom;width: 20;height: 20;" /> next to the drop-down menu.
4.  Use the up and down arrows to the side of the main window to change the order the validations will be run in.
5.  Click **Save**.

</div>

The validations will be run in the order in which the templates appear in the Ticket Validations screen. Tickets will be validated when they are imported, manually created, or edited. If the ticket values fall outside the ranges set in the validations, an exception is generated.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Remove">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Remove a Validation</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Remove">

<div class="procedure">

To remove a validation template:

1.  Click **Edit**.
2.  Select a validation template.
3.  Click the **remove** button 

<img src="data:image/png;base64," style="vertical-align: text-bottom;width: 20;height: 20;" /> in the lower-right corner of the window.
4.  Click **Save**.

</div>

</div>
